description: Seed recommended organization output presets for a use-case category (POST /v1/output_preset/apply_category). Categories: podcasting, music, ecommerce, audiobooks, voice_messages, video, general. Existing indexes are skipped. This is how "switch me to the podcast presets" works without the dashboard advisor. Requires AudioDN OAuth sign-in (call adn_sign_in or complete account login first).
name: adn_apply_output_preset_category
